scenario: Chest pain — urgent escalation, no advice

context.summary: Patient reports chest pain; agent refuses to assess and escalates urgently.

events.text: I've had chest pain and trouble breathing for the last hour.
I'm glad you told me, and I want you safe — chest pain and trouble breathing can be an emergency. Please call 911 or get to the nearest ER now. I'm connecting you to a nurse right away.

args.summary: Reports chest pain + dyspnea for 1 hour. Advised 911/ER. Needs immediate clinical contact.

events.name: Nurse Báez, RN
events.text: Sam, this is the triage nurse — are you able to call 911 right now or have someone take you to the ER? Let's stay on together.

suggested.reason: Do not assess symptoms; direct to 911/ER and escalate to a human urgently.
